edges.reason: claimNFT reads and increments claimNonces[recipient] to consume the nonce.
getClaimSigningHash embeds claimNonces[recipient] in the signed message.
claimNFT compares the recovered signer against the signVerifier state variable.
setSignVerifier writes the trusted signer address into signVerifier.
getSignVerifier returns the signVerifier state variable.
msg.sender is checked by onlyOwner before an upgrade is authorized.
msg.sender is checked by the onlyOwner modifier on setSignVerifier.
msg.sender is checked by the onlyOwner modifier on setBaseURI.
msg.sender is checked by the onlyOwner modifier on mint.
The attacker-supplied signature is fed into ECDSA.recover to derive the signer.
The recipient argument indexes the claimNonces mapping.
The locally computed message hash is the input to ECDSA recovery.
The resolved owner address is passed as the source of the safe transfer.
claimNFT invokes _safeTransfer which triggers the recipient's receiver callback.
mint invokes _safeMint which triggers the recipient's receiver callback.
claimNFT requires ECDSA.recover to return exactly the signVerifier before proceeding.
initialize hardcodes the signVerifier address.
initialize hardcodes the baseURI value.
setBaseURI writes the uri argument into baseURI.
claimNFT calls getClaimSigningHash to build the message to verify.
getClaimNonce reads claimNonces to return the current nonce.
The onlyOwner upgrade authorization precedes the delegatecall upgrade path.
The recipient's onERC721Received hook can reenter claimNFT before state finalization.
The mint recipient's onERC721Received hook can reenter the minting flow.
The delegatecall to the new implementation re-enters the upgrade authorization surface.
